description: Retrieve all receipts belonging to a chain, ordered by timestamp ascending to show the sequence of operations. A chain groups related receipts from a multi-step agent workflow. Returns the complete receipt objects for every step. Use to audit a complete workflow, calculate total chain cost and duration, or identify which step in a pipeline failed.

chain_id.description: The chain ID to retrieve (format: "chain_" followed by 8 alphanumeric characters)

name: get_chain
